en.title: Days Scented with Steam and Letterpress Ink
en.premise: An elderly grandfather running an old bookstore and his granddaughter, recently returned from the city, slowly bridge the distance between their hearts through the small moments of everyday life. An old notebook tucked away in the shop and meals shared around steaming bowls of soup gently unravel forgotten family memories. A story of healing and warmth, clumsily woven by two people who struggle to find the right words.

zh.title: 蒸汽与活字油墨飘香的日子
zh.premise: 经营着旧书店的祖父与从都市归来的孙女，在日常的点滴琐事中，逐渐拉近了彼此的心灵距离。店里的一本旧笔记本，以及围坐在热气腾腾的汤品旁的餐桌，缓缓揭开那段被遗忘的家族记忆。这是一个关于治愈与温暖的故事，由两个不善言辞的人，笨拙地编织而成。
